· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 270,000원 돌파 시 매수, 245,000원 이탈 시 매도 관망 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (270,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (257,400 KRW)/SMA20 (259,075 KRW)/SMA50 (264,323 KRW): short/mid-term trend above, diagnosed
· Position relative to SMA100 (273,780 KRW)/SMA200 (212,210 KRW): mid/long-term trend above, mid/long-term trend strength is good
· 52-week position (65.7%) + current price level is historically intermediate
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (50.0→54.2) + neutral range consolidation diagnosed + weak upward reversal attempt in direction
· MACD histogram trajectory (1882.1010→924.0906) + worsening diagnosed + weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band 259,075 KRW) + band width at 18.22% is normal
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (245,000 KRW) + based on Fibonacci 0.382 level
· Swing resistance (288,000 KRW) + aligns with 20-day high
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of trend directionality
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.19x) + reliability of movement is normal
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + buy on break above 270,000 KRW, wait-and-see on break below 245,000 KRW conditions
